description: This file defines React components related to displaying workflow input/output data in a compact, user-interactive manner. It includes UI components such as tabs, buttons, and data viewers, and manages workflow execution state to determine which data to display.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Formats a byte value into a human-readable string (e.g., KB, MB).

methods.name: CompactDataView
methods.description: A component to display a compact view of data, with options to view as formatted JSON or raw JSON, and to copy or view full data.

methods.name: CompactWorkflowInputOutput
methods.description: Main component to display workflow input/output data with tabbed interface, managing display modes and modals for full data viewing.
